## Problem and outcome

State the observable result, completion boundary and canonical Issue/task/journey. Describe why the change is needed and what remains unproven.

## Ownership and changes

Describe resulting behavior, source owners, scope and protected invariants. Reference canonical design/contracts instead of copying a second specification. For governance changes include actual authority and independent content review.

## Validation and delivery

Follow [Risk-based Gates](../doc/ci/RISK-BASED-GATES.md). Record exact base/head/tree, trusted classification/tier, applicable focused/Fast evidence, actual selected job results, independent quality receipt (repository/PR/base/head/tier/run/attempt) and reviewer findings/repairs.

Eligible ordinary docs record DOCS_AUTO_QUALIFIED / NOT_REQUIRED_DOCS per [docs policy](../doc/ci/DOCS-AUTO-DELIVERY.md). Skill/CI/rule changes require Full. Normal automatic qualification does not require repeated Human dispatch/waiver. Actual design/value/exception/production decisions remain separately authorized.

Before merge re-read current head/main, required checks, unresolved blocking review and actual GitHub controls. After merge record main SHA/tree and post-merge quality receipt. Use [task template](../doc/templates/task.md) for the complete evidence record. Do not call static/Mock/merge evidence production acceptance.

## Remaining conditions

Record missing resources/decisions, owner and recovery action, actual deployment authority and remaining outcome evidence. Optional manual Full diagnostics, if used, retain their own exact-head record and do not replace automatic qualification.
